correctness.rationale: The forward infection matrix has entries (d_i-1) beta psi_j d_j/(2K) and rank one; its nonzero eigenvalue is beta[psi_H d_H(d_H-1)+psi_L d_L(d_L-1)]/(2K). Exchanging ordered degrees reduces the objective when d_H>d_L. For d_H=K-r and d_L=K+r, the exact discrete increment F(r+1)-F(r)=2[(K+r)-rho(K-r-1)] is strictly increasing in r; its unique zero gives consecutive ratio thresholds, with no non-adjacent ties. K=2 and both endpoint inequalities included. Independence of psi_H on r=K-1 follows from d_H(d_H-1)=0. K=3 case returns 21/20 versus 1/6. Rechecked by independent exact rational enumeration K=2,...,16 around all thresholds; this finite sample corroborates the algebra, not an infinite proof.
